tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Supply installation and commissioning of online continous effluent monitoring system(OCEMS) and 50kw solar power systems for 5.0 mld stp plant in byadagi

itemList.description:
Item 1: 50 kW Solar Power Plant (On-Grid System)
Providing, erecting, testing, and commissioning of a 50 kW On-Grid Solar Power Generation System with high-efficiency photovoltaic modules, grid-tied inverters, galvanized mounting frames, junction boxes, necessary electrical cabling, and lightning/earthing protection. The solar plant shall synchronize with the STP’s electrical network to optimize energy consumption. Remote supervision facility shall be provided, and the plant shall conform to MNRE/IEC specifications

Item 2: Online Continuous Effluent Monitoring System (OCEMS)
Providing, installing, testing, and commissioning of OCEMS unit for automatic measurement and reporting of treated effluent parameters including pH, BOD, COD, TSS, Ammonia, and Flow. The system shall be equipped with precision probes, digital analyzers, a centralized data acquisition unit, industrial communication system, and protective outdoor housing.
